textos.Convierte la voz en texto dentro de tu c: Turns speech into text on your computer. Downloaded only once.
textos.Corta escucha tu video y escribe cada pa: Corta listens to your video and writes down every word with its timing.
Corta checks on its own every 6 hours.
textos.Corta usa la IA que ya tienes, con tu cu: Corta uses the AI you already have, with your own account. We'll test it with a short question.
textos.Editas el texto: lo que borras, se borra: You edit the text: whatever you delete is cut from the video.
textos.Ej.: corta desde «te muestro» hasta «cóm: E.g.: cut from “let me show you” to “how” and zoom in on “publish”
textos.Este video es corto: funciona mejor con: This video is short: it works best with videos over a minute and a half (a class, a podcast, a live stream).
textos.Este video todavía no tiene texto. Trans: This video has no text yet. Transcribe it to edit by words and add captions.
textos.Formato {l}, 1080 px, con subtítulos. Es: {l} format, 1080 px, with captions. This happens on your computer.
textos.Hechos con la transcripción, palabra por: Made from the transcript, word by word.
textos.La transcripción se hace en tu computado: Transcription happens on your computer. A 10-minute video takes a couple of minutes.
textos.Listo: el video quedó **{s} s** más cort: Done: the video is now **{s} s** shorter.
textos.MP4, MOV o WebM. También puedes arrastra: MP4, MOV or WebM. You can also drag it here.
Lower or closer to the center.
textos.Pon un título grande al inicio: Add a big title at the start
textos.Pon zoom cuando digo algo importante: Zoom in when I say something important
textos.Queda un video de **{d}** en formato {l}: You'll get a **{d}** video in {l} format, ready to upload.
textos.Saca la parte donde me equivoco: Cut the part where I mess up
textos.Saca las pausas largas y los «eh», «mmm»: Removes long pauses and the “uh”s and “um”s in one go.
textos.Todo se procesa en tu computador. La IA: Everything is processed on your computer. The AI uses your own account.
textos.Trae un video y Corta lo transcribe en t: Bring a video and Corta transcribes it on your computer. Then you remove silences and filler words, pick captions and export it vertical for Shorts, Reels or TikTok.
textos.Tu IA corta, pone zooms y busca los mejo: Your AI cuts, adds zooms and finds the best moments for Shorts.
textos.Tu video vertical de **{d}** quedó guard: Your **{d}** vertical video was saved in the project folder.
Your videos never leave your computer.
textos.Un editor para Shorts, Reels y TikTok qu: An editor for Shorts, Reels and TikTok that runs on your computer. It transcribes everything, you edit the text and your own AI does the heavy lifting. Free, no watermark.
textos.{ia} está buscando los mejores momentos…: {ia} is looking for the best moments…
textos.{ia} lee la transcripción y elige los mo: {ia} reads the transcript and picks 20–60 second moments that make sense on their own and hook from the start. Each becomes a new vertical video with captions.
textos.¿Quieres otro estilo? Los estilos son ar: Want another style? Styles are simple files anyone can create and share with the community.
textos.En la app, aquí eliges un video de tu co: In the app, you pick a video from your computer here
textos.En la app, aquí se transcribe el video: In the app, the video gets transcribed here
textos.En la app, aquí se abre la carpeta: In the app, the folder opens here
textos.En la vista previa la IA es de mentira:: In the preview the AI is pretend: in the app, your AI understands any request.
textos.Agregué el título «Edita en 1 minuto» al: I added the title “Edit in 1 minute” at the start.
textos.Cambié los subtítulos a una palabra a la: I switched the captions to one word at a time.
I made it square (1:1) for Instagram.
textos.Corté «Mmm… te muestro cómo», que sobrab: I cut “Hmm… let me show you how”, which wasn't needed.
textos.Ahorra una hora editando tus videos: Save an hour editing your videos
textos.Dos pasos y tu Short está listo: Two steps and your Short is ready
textos.Abre con una pregunta y una promesa conc: Opens with a question and a concrete promise.
textos.Pasos cortos y claros, ideal para guarda: Short, clear steps, great for saving.
While you're not talking. It lowers itself when you speak.
textos.Elige una canción de tu computador. Suen: Choose a song from your computer. It plays under your voice and lowers itself when you speak, so what you say is always clear.
textos.MP3, M4A, WAV, OGG o FLAC. Si es más cor: MP3, M4A, WAV, OGG or FLAC. If it's shorter than the video, it loops.
Loops if it's shorter than the video.
textos.Sin transcripción, la vista previa no ba: Without a transcript, the preview doesn't lower the music while you talk. The export does.
textos.Esta música está fuera de la carpeta del: This music is outside the project folder: it won't play in the preview, but it will in the export. Choose it again to bring it into the folder.
textos.Usa solo música tuya o libre: Only use your own or free music
textos.Las canciones conocidas tienen derechos: Well-known songs are copyrighted: YouTube, Instagram and TikTok may mute your video, block it or take away its earnings. Use music you made, music with a license that allows it in videos, or royalty-free music. If the license asks you to credit the author, add it to the description.
textos.En la vista previa suena una música de p: The preview plays a test track made by Corta
textos.Elige el video que quieres editar: Choose the video you want to edit
Choose an MP4, MOV or WebM video.
textos.En la vista previa no hay nada que actua: There's nothing to update in the preview.
textos.Espera a que termine de transcribir o ex: Wait until it finishes transcribing or exporting and try again.
textos.Espera a que termine lo que está haciend: Wait until this video finishes what it's doing.
textos.Instalando: Corta se cerrará y volverá a: Installing: Corta will close and reopen by itself
textos.La descarga llegó dañada. Intenta de nue: The download arrived damaged. Try again.
textos.No encontré la descarga de la versión nu: I couldn't find the new version's download.
textos.No pude descargar la versión nueva. Revi: I couldn't download the new version. Check your connection and try again.
textos.No pude preparar la versión nueva. Corta: I couldn't prepare the new version. Corta is the same as before; try again later.
I couldn't check. Check your connection.

textos.Primero descarga el transcriptor en Ajus: First download the transcriber in Settings.
Drop an MP4, MOV or WebM video.
A download is already in progress.
textos.Toca una palabra para ir a ese momento y: Tap a word to jump to that moment, and tap it again to fix it. Pick several (tap the first and the last with Shift) and press Delete to cut them from the video.
textos.Corregir cómo se escribe (o tócala otra: Fix how it's written (or tap it again)
textos.Corta corrige estas palabras al transcri: Corta fixes these words when it transcribes your next videos and teaches them to the transcriber, so it recognizes names and brands.
textos.Corta la corregirá sola al transcribir t: Corta will fix it on its own when it transcribes your next videos
textos.Escribe cómo va. Enter guarda y Esc canc: Type how it should read. Enter saves and Esc cancels; if you leave it empty, it's removed from the captions (the video isn't cut).
textos.La frase sigue con la siguiente: The caption continues with the next one
textos.Listo: cambié «{de}» por «{a}» 1 vez más: Done: I changed “{de}” to “{a}” 1 more time.
textos.Listo: cambié «{de}» por «{a}» {n} veces: Done: I changed “{de}” to “{a}” {n} more times.
textos.Todavía no hay nada. Cuando corrijas una: Nothing here yet. When you fix a caption word, tap “Remember for future videos”.
textos.¿Cambiar «{de}» por «{a}» en todo el vid: Change “{de}” to “{a}” everywhere in the video ({n} times)?
Change “{de}” to “{a}” everywhere in the video (1 time)?
textos.Lo recordaré en tus próximos videos: I'll remember it in your next videos
textos.Transcripción lista. Corregí {n} palabra: Transcription ready. I fixed {n} words with your vocabulary.
I don't know how to do that.
textos.{ia} usa tu cuenta y solo ve el texto co: {ia} uses your account and only sees the text with its timing, never the video. You can remove each change, even if you kept editing.
textos.Quitado. Dejé 1 cosa que cambiaste a man: Removed. I kept 1 thing you changed by hand.
textos.Quitado. Dejé {n} cosas que cambiaste a: Removed. I kept {n} things you changed by hand.
Done. I kept 1 thing you changed by hand.
textos.Listo. Dejé {n} cosas que cambiaste a ma: Done. I kept {n} things you changed by hand.
I added 3 zooms at the key moments.
textos.Divide el video en el cabezal (⌘B): Split the video at the playhead (⌘B)
textos.Gratis y abiertos. Cualquiera puede crea: Free and open. Anyone can make one without coding and share it.
textos.Gratis y hechos por personas como tú. So: Free and made by people like you. They're just data: Corta checks them before using them.
textos.No hay efectos con eso. Prueba en la com: No effects match. Try the community ones.
I couldn't connect. Check your connection.
textos.Recorta desde el cabezal hasta el final: Trim from the playhead to the end of the segment
textos.Recorta desde el inicio del tramo hasta: Trim from the start of the segment to the playhead
textos.Se aplica a todo el video. Para un solo: Applies to the whole video. For just one moment, pick words in Text or a segment on the timeline.
textos.Toca un tramo del video para borrarlo, r: Tap a segment of the video to delete it, trim it or add an effect. Drag the edges to adjust them.
textos.Un filtro o un efecto solo mientras se d: A filter or effect only while they're said
textos.Pon el cabezal dentro del video para div: Put the playhead inside the video to split
textos.Pon el cabezal dentro del tramo: Put the playhead inside the segment
textos.El efecto llegó dañado. Intenta de nuevo: The effect arrived damaged. Try again.
textos.Le puse el filtro «Cálido» a todo el vid: I gave the whole video the “Warm” filter.
textos.Cada clip va a su hueco con sus efectos: Each clip goes into its slot with its effects and texts. This happens on your computer.
textos.Elige una, pon tus clips o fotos y se ar: Pick one, add your clips or photos and it builds itself. Then fine-tune it like any other video.
textos.Plantilla «{x}». Cambia un clip o mueve: Template “{x}”. Change a clip or move the slider to choose which part of the video goes in its slot.
textos.Cambia un clip o mueve la barra para ele: Change a clip or move the slider to choose which part of the video goes in its slot.
textos.Si eliges menos, se repiten; si eliges m: If you choose fewer, they repeat; if you choose more, the extra ones are left out. Later you can change each one and pick which part of each video is used.
textos.Sin ellos la plantilla igual funciona, p: The template still works without them, just without those effects.
textos.Usa efectos de la comunidad que no tiene: Uses community effects you don't have
textos.Listo. Faltan {n} efectos de la comunida: Done. {n} community effects are missing: you can add them later.
textos.En la app, aquí eliges otro clip o foto: In the app, here you pick another clip or photo
textos.Los cortes van al ritmo de una música de: The cuts follow ~{b} BPM music: pick something similar in Music.
textos.Elige videos (MP4, MOV, WebM) o fotos (J: Choose videos (MP4, MOV, WebM) or photos (JPG, PNG, WebP).
Choose a clip or a photo.
textos.La plantilla llegó dañada. Intenta de nu: The template arrived damaged. Try again.
textos.Elige {n} clips o fotos. Van en orden de: Choose {n} clips or photos. They go in name order; you can change each one later.
textos.Elige otro clip o foto para este hueco: Choose another clip or photo for this slot
textos.Entra y sale suave: cámara lenta en el m: Eases in and out: slow motion right at the key moment.
textos.Mezcla los cuadros para que la cámara le: Blends frames so slow motion doesn't stutter.
textos.Inventa los cuadros que faltan. Exportar: Creates the missing frames. Exporting takes much longer.
textos.Dura {a} s y en el video, {b} s: Lasts {a} s, and {b} s in the video
textos.Este tramo es muy corto para cambiarle l: This segment is too short to change its speed
textos.Para una rampa, el tramo tiene que durar: A ramp needs a segment of at least half a second
textos.Puse cámara lenta, con una rampa suave,: I added slow motion, with a smooth ramp, on “ready to publish”.
textos.Bajo 0,5× la voz se silencia sola. La mú: Below 0.5× the voice is muted automatically. Music never changes speed.
textos.No encontré {ia} en este computador. Rev: I couldn't find {ia} on this computer. Check Settings → Your AI.
textos.{ia} se demoró demasiado en responder. I: {ia} took too long to answer. Please try again.

textos.Actualiza {ia} para usarla con {app}: tu: Update {ia} to use it with {app}: your version doesn't know the protections we need.
